statements.text: Stats: Retribution: Strength / attack power > Stamina > spell power > Intellect > Armour. Champion of the Light makes Intellect worth more than in Classic. Self-healing feels weak without +healing gear.

statements.title: Paladin (scope: forever)
statements.text: Weapons: Use a slow two-hander, which scales Holy Strike and Seal of Command. Other two-handers: Forsaken Greataxe (15, Horde), Ironforge Greathammer (16, Alliance), Crested Scepter (24, BFD), Debt Collector (26, Stockade), Heavehammer (31), Bonebiter (34, Alliance), Ravager (37).

statements.title: Paladin (scope: forever)
statements.text: Quests: Redemption quest at 12: The Tome of Divinity (Human/Dwarf) or A Lesson in Divinity (Undead, new).

statements.title: Paladin (scope: forever)
statements.text: Quests: Level-20 weapon: Verigan's Fist for Alliance (needs materials from Deadmines, SFK, Loch Modan and the BFD approach; the Forever version has a Holy proc). Wolfsbane for Horde/Undead (starts at 18; includes the elite Old Fire-Eye in Silverpine, so bring a partner). Mount quest at 40 (Tome of Nobility).

statements.title: Paladin (scope: forever)
statements.text: Mistakes: Skipping the Redemption or level-20 weapon quests, using Consecration on big packs, using Seal of Righteousness in a deep Retribution build (Vengeance needs Seal of Command), re-sealing after every Judgement, and using Seal of the Crusader the Classic way.

statements.title: Paladin (scope: forever)
statements.text: Solo/group: Retribution for solo single targets. Protection for Consecration pulls and dungeon tanking; Righteous Fury at 10 makes early tanking possible.

statements.title: Paladin (scope: classic_fallback)
statements.text: **✗** Classic Retribution order (Benediction → Improved Judgement → Seal of Command → Pursuit of Justice → Conviction, with a Reckoning respec at 32) does not transfer.

statements.title: Paladin (scope: classic_fallback)
statements.text: **✗** Seal of the Crusader until about 30 or with Verigan's Fist; Seal of Command on two-handers of 3.5 speed or slower; Seal of Righteousness on fast weapons. Improved Seal of the Crusader is gone and Judgement no longer consumes the seal.

statements.title: Paladin (scope: classic_fallback)
statements.text: Transfers: judge with Blessing of Wisdom up, don't heal to full, don't over-pull, and don't skip dungeons.

statements.title: Shaman (scope: forever)
statements.text: Race: Orc, Tauren, Troll, Skyborne or Dwarf (Dwarf is new and the only Alliance shaman race). Dwarf shamans get four new quest lines; the Water and Air totem calls can be done in Ironforge.

statements.title: Shaman (scope: forever)
statements.text: Changes: Windfury Weapon and Windfury Totem add an extra white swing.
Stormstrike is 100% weapon damage on an 8-second cooldown and Mental Dexterity converts 33/66/100% of Intellect to attack power (both changed 10 Nov).

statements.title: Shaman (scope: forever)
statements.text: Changes: Lightning Bolt base damage increased, Chain Lightning has a 2.5-second cast, and shocks are back to Classic base damage. **Lava Burst was removed at launch** (it became Call of Thunder). Elemental Mastery was renamed Lightning Mastery.

statements.title: Shaman (scope: forever)
statements.text: Changes: Totemic Projection is now Totemic Call (pulls your totems to you, 30-second cooldown). Call of the Elements (20) and Call of the Ancestors (30) drop a saved totem set with one button. Totem twisting is gone.

statements.title: Shaman (scope: forever)
statements.text: Changes: Fire Nova detonates through your active Fire totem, and its threat goes to the shaman. Water Shield (Restoration, about 20) returns mana when you are hit.

statements.title: Shaman (scope: forever)
statements.text: Spec: Enhancement is the levelling spec. Elemental is mana-hungry. Restoration is weak solo before dual spec at 40.

statements.title: Shaman (scope: forever)
statements.text: Spec: Enhancement. The levelling build ends near 6/34/11; key talents and the level to have them by: Thundering Strikes 5 by 14; Mental Dexterity 3 by 17; Shamanistic Focus by 20; Stormstrike by 25; Spirit Weapons by 43; Rage of the Farseer by 46.

statements.title: Shaman (scope: forever)
statements.text: Spec: Method: Stormstrike at 25, then Improved Ghost Wolf 2/2 straight away for an instant-cast Ghost Wolf.

statements.title: Shaman (scope: forever)
statements.text: Spells: Key levels: Rockbiter and Lightning Bolt 1; Earth Shock and Stoneskin Totem (quest) 4; Earthbind 6; Lightning Shield and Stoneclaw 8; Flame Shock, Searing Totem (quest), Flametongue and Strength of Earth 10; Fire Nova and Purge 12; Ghost Wolf, Frost Shock, Healing Stream (quest), Lesser Healing Wave and Call of the Elements 20; Magma and Mana Spring 26; Windfury Weapon, Call of the Ancestors, Grounding and Reincarnation 30; Chain Lightning and Windfury Totem 32. (The guide also lists Lava Burst at 30, which no longer exists.)

statements.title: Shaman (scope: forever)
statements.text: Rotation: Early: Flame Shock, Searing Totem, melee, Earth or Frost Shock on cooldown, refresh Flame Shock. Later: keep Lightning Shield and Windfury Weapon up, pull with Lightning Bolt, Flame Shock, Stormstrike on cooldown, Earth Shock as filler, and spend Maelstrom Weapon at 5 stacks. Drop only the totems that matter now.

statements.title: Shaman (scope: forever)
statements.text: Stats: Contradiction: Method puts Agility first (Agility > Strength > Stamina > Intellect), while Warcraft Tavern puts it last (Hit > Strength > Intellect > Crit > spell power > Agility).

statements.title: Shaman (scope: forever)
statements.text: Weapons: Rockbiter with a two-hander (or one-hander and shield) until 30, then Windfury on a slow two-hander. Options: Ironforge Greathammer (16), Smite's Mighty Hammer / Rockslicer (18, Deadmines), Corpsemaker (29, RFK), Rage of the Storm (30+).

statements.title: Shaman (scope: forever)
statements.text: Quests: Totem quests: Earth 4, Fire 10, Water 20, Air 30. Skyborne also get the Totem of Charged Flames relic.

statements.title: Shaman (scope: forever)
statements.text: Quests: Rage of the Storm is a new level-30 weapon quest that opens after the Air totem quest. It runs through RFK, Thousand Needles and Alterac. Beta reward: a 3.20-speed two-handed mace that boosts Stormstrike damage, offered instead of Elemental and Restoration alternatives. The beta version had level-40 elites.

statements.title: Shaman (scope: forever)
statements.text: Mistakes: Dropping too many totems, levelling as Elemental without managing mana, levelling as Restoration solo before 40, ignoring weapon skill when changing weapon type (two-handed maces are trained in Ironforge or Thunder Bluff), and following stale beta builds with Lava Burst or Totemic Projection.

statements.title: Shaman (scope: forever)
statements.text: Solo/group: Solo: Enhancement, one mob at a time. Group: tank with one-hander and shield, Rockbiter, Earth Shock and Fire Nova. Raid-wide totems make shamans welcome in groups.

statements.title: Shaman (scope: classic_fallback)
statements.text: **✗ uncertain**: use Rockbiter on a two-hander of 3.4 speed or slower. Forever guides switch to Windfury at 30, now that Windfury adds an extra swing.

statements.title: Shaman (scope: classic_fallback)
statements.text: Classic calls the Water totem quest long and optional. Unchecked for Forever.

statements.title: Shaman (scope: classic_fallback)
statements.text: Don't refresh Lightning Shield early, and don't fight several mobs at once.

statements.title: Druid (scope: forever)
statements.text: Race: Night Elf, Tauren or Skyborne (both factions; new). Skyborne have their own form quests on Zephras Isle.

statements.title: Druid (scope: forever)
statements.text: Changes: Form auto-attacks use the equipped weapon's DPS. Weapon enchants and procs, most consumables and racials work in forms. Weapons therefore matter for Feral, unlike in Classic.

statements.title: Druid (scope: forever)
statements.text: Changes: Omen of Clarity is baseline at 20, Nature's Grasp at 10 and Revive at 12. Faerie Fire can be cast in forms at no cost. Feral Charge also works in Cat Form.

statements.title: Druid (scope: forever)
statements.text: Changes: Bear and Dire Bear threat is 115%. Shred, Claw and Ravage were buffed, and Rip, Rake, Ferocious Bite and Pounce got about +25%. Ferocious Bite rank 1 at 24. Shred at 20. Berserk removed. Lacerate is a 1-point Feral talent. Combo points stay when you switch targets.

statements.title: Druid (scope: forever)
statements.text: Changes: Furor (now in Feral) keeps energy when you shift from Cat to Bear. Shifting Power (Feral, about 40) turns mana into 40 energy; use it below 50 energy.

statements.title: Druid (scope: forever)
statements.text: Quests: Bear Form at 10 (Heeding the Call or the Skyborne version). Cure Poison at 14. Aquatic Form at 16 (Moonglade). **Cat Form at 20 is now a quest** (The Great Cat Spirit, Moonglade). Travel Form is trained at 30 (+40% speed outdoors). Dire Bear at 40. Teleport: Moonglade from 10.

statements.title: Druid (scope: forever)
statements.text: Quests: No druid weapon quest exists before 60.

statements.title: Druid (scope: forever)
statements.text: Spec: Feral (cat) is the consensus levelling spec. Balance is viable (Method suggests switching after 30). Restoration is slow.

statements.title: Druid (scope: forever)
statements.text: Spec: Feral Combat. The levelling build ends near 9/37/5; key talents and the level to have them by: Ferocity 5 by 14; Feral Instinct 3 by 19; Feral Charge by 21; Lacerate by 26; Predatory Discipline by 28; Leader of the Pack by 30; Shifting Power by 40; Primal Bite by 41.

statements.title: Druid (scope: forever)
statements.text: Spec: Method's priority: Ferocity, Feral Swiftness, Leader of the Pack, Predatory Strikes, Primal Bite, Shifting Power, then Balance and Restoration (Genesis 5, Nature's Majesty, Nature's Reach, Heart of the Wild). Feral Swiftness is called the strongest early levelling talent.

statements.title: Druid (scope: forever)
statements.text: Rotation: 1–10: Wrath, Moonfire, melee when out of mana, Rejuvenation. 10–20: Bear (Enrage, Demoralizing Roar, Maul, Swipe for packs). 20–30: Prowl, Shred from behind (otherwise Claw), Faerie Fire, Rake, Rip or Ferocious Bite. 30+: Prowl, Ravage, Faerie Fire, Rake, Claw to 5 combo points, Ferocious Bite, Shifting Power below 50 energy.

statements.title: Druid (scope: forever)
statements.text: Stats: Contradiction: Warcraft Tavern says Strength / Agility / attack power > Stamina / Intellect / Spirit. Method says Feral levelling gear should favour Intellect and Spirit (Shifting Power costs mana), and that weapon DPS matters.

statements.title: Druid (scope: forever)
statements.text: Weapons: Gear examples: Smite's Mighty Hammer (18), Defender of Dalaran (30, Alliance), The Pacifier (36), Grimlok's Charge (42).

statements.title: Druid (scope: forever)
statements.text: Mistakes: Lingering in caster form before 10 and 20 (do the Bear and Cat quests promptly), bleeds on dying or immune targets, overusing Shifting Power until you have no mana for healing, and following beta builds with Berserk or a baseline Lacerate.

statements.title: Druid (scope: forever)
statements.text: Solo/group: Solo as Cat (stealth, Dash, Travel Form). In groups, a hybrid Feral build can tank as Bear (115% threat) and contributes Rebirth.

statements.title: Druid (scope: forever)
statements.text: Contradiction: Tiger's Fury: one source says it comes at 24 (+15% damage), another says it was removed. Unresolved.

statements.title: Druid (scope: classic_fallback)
statements.text: **✗** Bear from 10 to about 31, then Cat from 32. Forever guides use Cat from 20, now a quest.

statements.title: Druid (scope: classic_fallback)
statements.text: **✗** "Weapons are just stat sticks." Forever form attacks use weapon DPS.

Riverglades is designed for about levels 38–44. Players advise arriving around 40.
Completing all Riverglades quests gives roughly 4–5 levels.
Hidden Horde quest Farholde Scouting Report starts by killing Cavalry Scout Alturin. It gives 4,850 XP, but the area PvP-flags you.
Horde should bring to Riverglades: 10 Chunk of Boar Meat, 10 Heavy Weightstone, and 12 Iron Bar plus 4 Thick Leather for Key Ingredients.
The Honored 10% riding discount does not work for Skyborne. Their trainer has no faction, so Journeyman Riding stays 1,000g.
After Zephras Isle, Skyborne faction reputation comes only from repeatable runecloth turn-ins: 150 reputation per 60 Runecloth.
The repeatable quest Water Pouch Bounty no longer gives XP.
Type /console showInGameNavigation 1 to show a yellow in-world marker on the tracked quest's objective or turn-in, which helps when the target is above or below you.
Spectral Iron Ore can be tracked by miners and spawns more often. The Depleted Crystal Heart for "Heart of Crystal" drops for every party member.
Known issue: the Ashenvale quest "Vorsha the Lasher" is disabled until a crash bug is fixed, so it cannot be done for now.
Skyborne at Honored reputation get the 10% gold discount on Apprentice and Journeyman Riding from the trainer on Zephras Isle (fixed 19 Nov).
Skyborne now get the 10% Honored reputation discount on Apprentice and Journeyman Riding bought from the riding trainer on Zephras Isle (fixed 19 Nov).

Forever's developers said in podcast episode 8 (19 Nov) that spell power gear is too scarce between levels 15 and 40 and that later patches will add more; they also plan bigger bags and better ways to sort and search them.
When a group kills Witch Doctor Ti’ik, multiple copies of his head can drop for players on his quest.
Known issue: Biding Our Time can give Filcher's Cowl as an unusable item with a red question mark. Blizzard is investigating.
Witch Doctor Ti'ik now drops a head for each group member on the quest (20 Nov), and Gor'marok respawns faster for The Dunemaul Compound.
The Pendulum of Doom can no longer be made: its Axe of Lingering Dread half came from the Obsidian Sentinel.
Mosh'gra in Riverglades can now drop his rare loot; a bug had prevented it until 19 Nov.
On the Alterac quest "Stormpike's Deciphering", a destroyed Ensorcelled Parchment can now be obtained again.
The quest "Hunting for Ectoplasm" now uses the correct creature type for gathering ectoplasm (fixed 19 Nov).
Gor'marok in Tanaris respawns faster for the quest "The Dunemaul Compound" (20 Nov).
In Feralas, Perfect Yeti Hide no longer drops again while you are already on the quest it starts (20 Nov).
Quests more than 5 levels under your level pay 10-20% less XP for each further level of difference.
Level colour bands for quests and mobs: grey is 5+ levels below, green 3-4 below, yellow within 2 either way, orange 3-4 above, red 5+ above. Grey mobs give no kill XP.
In a group, each member loots quest drops separately. Forever adds some bad-luck protection so that one member does not fall far behind on drops.
Forever penalises kill XP more harshly when a much higher-level player is in the group, so boosting by a level 60 is ineffective. Group with players in your level range.
Encrypted Twilight Texts drop for the three Silithus story quests. The repeatable reputation turn-in remains disabled. Still Believing can award a recipe by mail.
The Obsidian Sentinel in Uldaman can drop the Axe of Lingering Dread again. That puts the axe component for Pendulum of Doom back in reach.
You can use the Night Watchman’s Torch while riding or casting a spell.
The disguise for Scarlet Subterfuge lasts 60 minutes in the Western Plaguelands, twice its previous duration.
Two Wetlands quests award Ironforge reputation after the November 23 fix. Look for Uncovering the Past and Gleaning Our Future.

open_questions.text: **Hearthstone cooldown** in Forever. Assumed to be 60 minutes; not stated anywhere. Is there any Legacy or other way to reduce it?
**Death penalty threshold**: level 10 (MeinMMO) or 11 (Classic)? Durability loss and resurrection sickness values for Forever?

**Rested XP outside rested areas**: does logging out in the open world still build rest at a quarter of the rate? Does a Cozy Sleeping Bag count as a logout rested area? How long is the Boosted Rest cooldown?
**Dungeon kill XP versus Classic** as an official percentage, and the dungeon-quest XP values after launch, especially above level 30.
**Measured XP per hour** for questing versus a repeat dungeon run after the Nov 8 and Nov 15 changes. No data exists.
**Gathering XP**: do herbs and ore give XP in Forever?
Is "leaving a dungeon group ports you to your hearth location" intended, and can it be used as a free hearth?
**Prices**: official riding and mount prices (the guide figures are from the beta), dual spec price, and live respec pricing.
**Official level ranges** for Riverglades, Shen'dralas and Mount Hyjal. Will Shen'dralas get a flight path?
**Skyborne Alliance**: how they get from the Dalaran landing to Westfall. A Skyborne-only Stormwind portal is reported but unverified.
Do Night Elves cross to Westfall after Darkshore? Does the Horde route start in Silverpine or the Barrens (Polestar's guide files need checking)?
**Weapon grants**: does any automatic or Legacy-based weapon grant exist? Needs an in-game or datamine check.
**Talent data**: the TraitTree tables for build 1.60.x (wago.tools was unreachable). Exact post-Nov-2 talent orders from Icy Veins and Mobalytics (403 errors).
**Forever spell-rank skip lists** for every class. None have been published. With training normalised to about 206 g, how much does skipping still save?

**Class-specific gaps**: Priest: whether Spirit Tap exists, and Binding Heal's status. Mage: which quest gives "Study", where scrolls drop, the buff values, and whether Horde training in Dalaran is live. Druid: whether Tiger's Fury exists. Warlock: whether Wrack was nerfed on Nov 11. Warrior: "Legacy of Valor" and its meaning. Rogue: whether "Blade of Cunning" is a level-10 reward. Warrior: whether "Thur'Grim's Axe" is a level-10 reward. **Hunter pet scaling** (10% of attack power and 100% of crit is unverified). Best Beast Mastery pet: cat or bear?
**Unresolved stat priorities**: Shaman (Agility first or last) and Feral Druid (Strength/Agility or Intellect/Spirit).
The final stats of Verigan's Fist, Wolfsbane and Rage of the Storm at launch. Do the level-40 elites in the shaman chain remain?
The steps of the Horde (Undead) Paladin Charger and level-40 mount quests.
Is the Mage level-10 "Mage-tastic Gizmonitor" quest live? Is the Comprehension "Study" quest named anywhere?
